description: Repairs r-def-cursor-dao/prov-alias-fields-metadata, query-field-metadata-aggregates, query-field-metadata-expressions, recordset-field-properties: the fixture was opened read-only, so DataUpdatable read False for every field. On a writable Database: a dynaset over "SELECT ID, N AS N1, N AS N2, N + 1 AS Np, S & 'x' AS Sx, T.S FROM T WHERE ID <= 3 ORDER BY ID": Updatable, and for each field by its own call Name, Type, Size, Attributes, DataUpdatable, SourceTable, SourceField, Required and OrdinalPosition; every row. A snapshot over "SELECT Count(*) AS Cn, Count(S) AS Cs, Sum(N) AS Sn, Avg(N) AS An, Min(S) AS Ms, Max(D) AS Md, Min(Fl) AS Mf FROM T" and one over "SELECT N + 1 AS A1, N * 1.5 AS A2, S & 'x' AS A3, IIf(N > 20, 'a', 'b') AS A4, CInt(N) AS A5, CDbl(N) AS A6, Format(D, 'yyyy') AS A7, Now() AS A8, Null AS A9, True AS A10, 'lit' AS A11, 7 AS A12, 7.5 AS A13, #1/1/2020# AS A14 FROM T WHERE ID = 1": for each field by its own call the wide member list (the nine above plus CollatingOrder, AllowZeroLength, ValidationRule, ValidationText, DefaultValue, CollectionIndex, ForeignName, Expression, ValidateOnSet); the row. For a Field of a dynaset over T (N), of a join (PA.V) and an expression Field (N + 1 AS Np): Properties Count, and each Property's Name, Type, Inherited and Value. Nothing is written. Asks the per-field origin, type and updatability of aliases, expressions, aggregates and join fields on a writable open. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
